photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 14:57:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 764 s; on-screen clock 05/16/13 14:57:50, wanted 14:57:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-135  msg 14:57' on 2013-05-15 (`as run matrix!B119`), read as 2013-05-15 14:57. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-05-15 plus one day, 14:57: it was found 714 s into this video, and in no other video.
